terms.definition: A substance that takes part in a chemical reaction — a starting material.
terms.function: Provides the atoms that get rearranged into products.
terms.whereItIs: The hydrogen and oxygen molecules on the left of the equation.
terms.whyItMatters: Every reaction begins with its reactants.

terms.definition: A shorthand description of a reaction, with reactants on the left and products on the right.
terms.function: Shows what reacts and what is produced at a glance.
terms.whereItIs: The whole left-arrow-right scene in the model.
terms.whyItMatters: Equations are the language of chemistry.

terms.definition: The using-up of reactants as a reaction proceeds.
terms.function: Turns starting materials into new substances while conserving atoms.
terms.whereItIs: The atoms flowing from left to right in the model.
terms.whyItMatters: Consumption explains how matter transforms without being lost.
